nodes.description: Address of the contract owner, set from msg.sender in the Owned constructor and updated by transferOwnership; guards onlyOwner functions.
uint8 lock flag (0 = unlocked) in Tokenlock; freeze sets it to 1, unfreeze to 0; gates the validLock modifier.
Mapping(address=>bool) in UserLock tracking blocked users; read by permissionCheck and written by lockUser/unlockUser.
Public token symbol, hardcoded to 'SWP' in the constructor.
Public token name, hardcoded to 'SWProtocol' in the constructor.
uint8 token decimals, set to 18 in the constructor.
Total token supply; set at construction and decreased by burn and burnForAllowance.
Mapping(address=>uint) of token balances; mutated by transfer, transferFrom, burn, burnForAllowance and the constructor.
Nested mapping(address=>mapping(address=>uint)) of approvals; written by approve/approveAndCall and reduced by transferFrom.
Caller-controlled address used as owner initializer, modifier check, and balance/allowance owner in transfer, approve, transferFrom, burn, approveAndCall.
SWProtocol constructor: sets metadata, mints the fixed supply to owner and emits Transfer.
onlyOwner function that reassigns owner to newOwner and emits OwnershipTransferred.
onlyOwner function that sets isLocked = 1 to freeze token transfers.
onlyOwner function that sets isLocked = 0 to unfreeze token transfers.
onlyOwner function that adds an address to the blacklist mapping.
onlyOwner function that removes an address from the blacklist mapping.
View function returning _totalSupply minus balances[address(0)].
View function returning balances[tokenOwner].
External ERC20 transfer guarded by validLock and permissionCheck; debits msg.sender and credits to.
External approval guarded by validLock and permissionCheck; writes allowed[msg.sender][spender].
External transferFrom guarded by validLock and permissionCheck; debits from and its allowance for msg.sender, credits to.
View function returning allowed[tokenOwner][spender].
Burns msg.sender's tokens, reducing _totalSupply and emitting a Transfer to address(0).
Sets allowance then performs an external call to spender.receiveApproval, enabling an untrusted callback into the token.
onlyOwner burn that takes a 20% fee: reduces _totalSupply and account balance, credits feeAccount with the fee.
Payable fallback function that unconditionally reverts to reject ETH.
onlyOwner rescue function that calls transfer on an arbitrary token address passed by the owner.
External call ApproveAndCallFallBack(spender).receiveApproval(...) executed after allowance state is written.
External call ERC20Interface(tokenAddress).transfer(owner, tokens) on an arbitrary caller-supplied contract address.
New owner address supplied to transferOwnership.
Recipient address of transfer.
Amount of tokens moved by transfer.
Spender address approved in approve.
Allowance amount granted in approve.
Debited account in transferFrom.
Credited account in transferFrom.
Amount moved by transferFrom.
Account queried in balanceOf.
Number of tokens destroyed by burn.
Contract approved and called back in approveAndCall.
Allowance amount granted in approveAndCall.
Arbitrary calldata forwarded to receiveApproval in approveAndCall.
Account whose balance is burned in burnForAllowance.
Account receiving the 20% fee in burnForAllowance.
Gross amount processed by burnForAllowance.
Arbitrary token contract address used in transferAnyERC20Token.
Token amount rescued by transferAnyERC20Token.
Address added to the blacklist by lockUser.
Address removed from the blacklist by unlockUser.
Spender queried in allowance.
Token owner queried in allowance.
Local computed as amount.mul(2).div(10) in burnForAllowance.
Local computed as amount.sub(feeAmount) in burnForAllowance.

edges.reason: newOwner parameter flows into the owner state variable inside transferOwnership.
to parameter is credited in transfer.
tokens parameter determines the amount debited/credited in transfer.
spender parameter indexes allowed[...][spender] in approve.
tokens parameter is stored as the allowance value in approve.
from parameter is the debited account in transferFrom.
to parameter is the credited account in transferFrom.
tokens parameter is removed from balance and allowance in transferFrom.
tokenOwner parameter indexes the balances mapping in balanceOf.
value parameter is subtracted from balance and total supply in burn.
spender parameter is both the approved address and the callee of receiveApproval.
tokens parameter is stored in allowed and forwarded to receiveApproval.
data parameter is forwarded verbatim to the external receiveApproval call.
account parameter is the burned account in burnForAllowance.
feeAccount parameter receives feeAmount in burnForAllowance.
amount parameter drives feeAmount, burnAmount and all balance updates.
tokenAddress parameter is cast to ERC20Interface and called.
tokens parameter is forwarded into the external token transfer call.
who parameter is written to the blacklist mapping in lockUser.
who parameter is cleared in the blacklist mapping in unlockUser.
spender parameter indexes allowed in allowance.
tokenOwner parameter indexes allowed in allowance.
msg.sender becomes owner in the Owned constructor and is compared against owner by onlyOwner.
msg.sender indexes the blacklist in the permissionCheck modifier.
The Owned constructor sets owner from msg.sender during deployment.
transferOwnership overwrites the owner state variable.
freeze writes isLocked = 1 and is gated by onlyOwner.
unfreeze writes isLocked = 0 and is gated by onlyOwner.
lockUser writes true into the blacklist mapping.
unlockUser writes false into the blacklist mapping.
Constructor assigns the symbol string.
Constructor assigns the name string.
Constructor assigns decimals = 18.
Constructor mints _totalSupply = 10000 * 10**decimals.
Constructor credits the whole supply to balances[owner].
totalSupply reads _totalSupply.
totalSupply subtracts balances[address(0)] from the supply.
balanceOf reads the balances mapping.
transfer writes balances[msg.sender] and balances[to].
approve writes allowed[msg.sender][spender].
transferFrom writes balances[from] and balances[to].
transferFrom decrements allowed[from][msg.sender].
allowance reads the allowed mapping.
burn decreases _totalSupply.
burn decreases balances[msg.sender].
approveAndCall writes allowed[msg.sender][spender] before the external callback, leaving state inconsistent during the call.
approveAndCall forwards control to the untrusted receiveApproval external call.
burnForAllowance decreases _totalSupply by burnAmount.
burnForAllowance debits balances[account] and credits balances[feeAccount].
transferAnyERC20Token invokes the external token transfer call.
The external receiveApproval call can re-enter approveAndCall (or other token functions) before the first invocation returns.
A malicious spender contract re-entering during receiveApproval can observe/abuse the already-written allowed state and drain allowances.
validLock modifier requires isLocked == 0 before transfer executes.
validLock modifier gates approve on isLocked.
validLock modifier gates transferFrom on isLocked.
validLock modifier gates burn on isLocked.
validLock modifier gates approveAndCall on isLocked.
permissionCheck modifier requires the caller not be blacklisted in transfer.
permissionCheck modifier blocks blacklisted callers from approve.
permissionCheck modifier blocks blacklisted callers from transferFrom.
permissionCheck modifier blocks blacklisted callers from burn.
permissionCheck modifier blocks blacklisted callers from approveAndCall.
onlyOwner modifier on transferOwnership checks msg.sender == owner.
onlyOwner modifier on freeze checks msg.sender == owner.
onlyOwner modifier on unfreeze checks msg.sender == owner.
onlyOwner modifier on lockUser checks msg.sender == owner.
onlyOwner modifier on unlockUser checks msg.sender == owner.
onlyOwner modifier on burnForAllowance lets the owner burn any account's balance.
onlyOwner modifier on transferAnyERC20Token restricts the arbitrary external call to the owner.

normalization_plan.reason: newOwner is only used as the assignment source for owner inside transferOwnership.
to is only used as the credited key of the balances mapping inside transfer.
tokens is only used as the arithmetic amount inside transfer.
spender is only used as the second index of the allowed mapping inside approve.
tokens is only used as the value written to allowed inside approve.
from is only used as the debited account and allowance owner inside transferFrom.
to is only used as the credited account inside transferFrom.
tokens is only used as the moved amount inside transferFrom.
tokenOwner is only used as the lookup key in balanceOf.
value is only used as the subtracted amount in burn.
spender is used both as allowance key and as the callee of the external call in approveAndCall.
tokens is only used as the allowance value and forwarded amount in approveAndCall.
data is only forwarded to the external receiveApproval call in approveAndCall.
account is only the burned balance holder in burnForAllowance.
feeAccount only receives the computed fee in burnForAllowance.
amount is the sole arithmetic driver of balances and supply in burnForAllowance.
tokenAddress is only cast to ERC20Interface and called in transferAnyERC20Token.
tokens is only forwarded to the external transfer call in transferAnyERC20Token.
who is only used as the blacklist key set to true in lockUser.
who is only used as the blacklist key set to false in unlockUser.
spender is only used as the inner key read by allowance.
tokenOwner is only used as the outer key read by allowance.
feeAmount is a temporary computed as amount.mul(2).div(10) inside burnForAllowance.
burnAmount is a temporary computed as amount.sub(feeAmount) inside burnForAllowance.
